name: United Arab Emirates
shortSummary: The UAE is one of India's most consequential Gulf partners — a top-three trading partner, home to roughly 3.5 million Indian expatriates, and India's first Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement signed in the 2020s.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Roughly 3.5 million Indian expatriates make the UAE one of India's largest remittance sources.
UAE sovereign funds are major investors in Indian infrastructure and renewable energy.

recentDevelopments.title: CEPA-driven trade continues rapid growth
recentDevelopments.description: Non-oil bilateral trade continued expanding rapidly under the 2022 Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: The UAE has become one of the clearest success stories of India's post-2020 trade agreement push.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued I2U2 and Gulf connectivity initiatives
recentDevelopments.description: India and the UAE continued advancing I2U2 grouping initiatives alongside broader India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) planning.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Positions the UAE as a central node in India's wider West Asia and connectivity strategy.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and the UAE upgrade relations to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership during PM Modi's visit.

historicalEvents.title: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
historicalEvents.description: India-UAE CEPA enters into force, one of India's fastest-negotiated and most comprehensive modern trade agreements.

historicalEvents.title: UPI-Domestic Card Payment Linkage
historicalEvents.description: India and the UAE link digital payment systems, enabling India's UPI to operate in the UAE.

agreements.name: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement
agreements.description: Comprehensive tariff-reduction and services agreement, among the most extensive India has concluded.

defenceCooperation.name: Desert Eagle
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral air force exercise between India and the UAE.

trade.majorExports: Petroleum products, gems and jewellery, engineering goods

multilateralRelations.detail: India, Israel, UAE and US grouping focused on infrastructure and technology cooperation.
India engages the GCC as a bloc alongside bilateral UAE ties.

leaders.name: Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
leaders.position: President of the United Arab Emirates
